Who we are

Rooted in agriculture. Focused on your success.

Ridge Point Ag Personnel Inc. is an agricultural labor contracting business based in Mendota, California. We work to support growers with dependable personnel and practical labor solutions that fit their operations.

Our approach is built on communication, accountability, and respect for each grower's expectations and requirements.

What we do

Agricultural labor services

We aim to help growers meet seasonal and day-to-day workforce needs. Contact us to discuss service availability for your operation.

Harvesting

Labor support for crop harvesting operations.

Planting

Personnel for planting and field establishment activities.

Pruning

Workforce assistance for pruning and crop maintenance.

Weeding

Field labor support for weed management tasks.

Packing

Personnel support for agricultural packing work.
